 Job Title: Systems Developer- Linux 
 Location: Parsippany, NJ 
 Duration: 6+ Months Contract 
 
 Job Description: 
 The role of the Systems Developer is to develop and maintain code which automates system management tasks to speed system delivery, ensure consistency and enforce standards. The candidate must have a strong understanding of Linux-based system administration and significant experience using scripting languages such as PERL, PHP and shell scripting to automate system administration tasks. 
 The ideal candidate will have at least 5 years experience as a system administrator and provide examples of previous automation experience as outlined above. 
 Required skills: 
 • Significant Linux system administration experience in a large heterogeneous environment 
 • Proven ability designing and developing scripts to automate system administration activities 
 • Strong experience in PERL and Shell scripting with code samples provided 
 • Experience with virtualization technologies; OVM or Solaris Domains preferred 
 • Strong experience with network services such as DNS, LDAP, Print Services, etc. 
 • Experience with XML technologies such as XSL, XQuery, XSD, SOAP, WSDL, XPath 
 • Experience with FIM tools such as OSSEC or TripWire 
 • Experience with security scanners such as Nessus and/or assessment services such as TrustWave 
 • Experience with SEIM tools such as Splunk 
 • Deployment and administration of two-factor authentication solutions such as SecurID or Duo Security 
 • Experience hardening systems using tools such as TCP Wrappers, PAM, SELinux & iptables 
 • Administration of enterprise class backup solutions such as NetBackup 
 • Experience with EMC SAN solutions such as VMAX and XtremIO 
 Preferred Skills: 
 • Solaris system administration 
 • Experience writing SQL code 
 • Oracle E-Business Suite 
 • Scrum/Agile methodologies 
 • System administration within a PCI environment 
 Preferred Certifications: 
 Oracle Certified Associate, Oracle Linux 5 and 6 System Administrator Certification or Oracle Certified Professional, Oracle Linux 6 System Administrator Certification 
 Oracle Certified Associate, Oracle Solaris 11 System Administrator or Oracle Certified Professional, Oracle Solaris 11 System Administrator 
 Oracle VM 3.0 for x86 Certified Implementation Specialist
